'''Bantam Dxun Reapers''' were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creatures of [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]] used as mounts around [[3626 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Bantam Dxun Reaper appears as a mount for the [[2019]] expansion to the videogame ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', called [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']].
